page_title: TinyRecorder — Free, Lightweight Screen Recorder for Mac

sources.entry: TinyRecorder - Lightweight screen recorder for screens, windows, apps, system audio and a connected iPhone or iPad; a maintained fork of QuickRecorder. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/33to9/TinyRecorder) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: TinyRecorder
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source, lightweight screen recorder for Mac that captures a full display, an area, windows, a single app, system audio, or a connected iPhone or iPad.
use_cases: Recording a single window or app on a Mac
Capturing a dragged area of the screen
Recording system audio without a microphone setup
Recording an iPhone or iPad screen over a cable
Making a quick screen demo to share
Keeping a QuickRecorder-style recorder working on newer macOS
summary.what_it_does: TinyRecorder records a whole display, a dragged screen area, one or more windows, a single app, or only system audio. It can also record the screen of an iPhone or iPad connected by cable, without installing anything on the device. The page says it keeps the menu bar controls (stop, pause, camera) working on macOS 27. It is a maintained fork of QuickRecorder by lihaoyun6, whose development stopped in mid-2025. Installation is offered via a single Terminal curl command, Homebrew, or a DMG download.
notable: Maintained fork of QuickRecorder that fixes menu bar controls on macOS 27
Records a connected iPhone or iPad over cable with no app on the phone
Install via Terminal one-liner, Homebrew, or DMG
caveats: Mac only; the iPhone/iPad feature requires a cable connection
The page does not state any paid tier; pricing is described as free and open source
